summary: Improve asset risk assessments, coverage reviews, renewals and claims tracking. Explore the five-day training outline and course outcomes.
lede: Asset protection and risk management connect asset records, threat assessments and insurance decisions. For intermediate risk, insurance and asset practitioners, the course builds practical skills in assessing asset criticality, reviewing controls and coverage gaps, and preparing renewal and claims records. You also practise updating risk registers and reporting actions, with introductory attention to scenario testing and changing cyber, climate and technology exposures.
audienceIntro: This course suits intermediate practitioners who maintain asset and exposure records, coordinate coverage or claims, inspect controls, and report unresolved risks to management. It is designed for professionals who need to make risk actions and insurance information work together in day-to-day operations.
prerequisites: Prior experience in asset protection, risk assessment, insurance coordination or claims support is recommended. You should be able to work with organizational asset and policy information; exercises focus on reviewing and structuring records rather than coding.
